verdict.rationale: The documented API covers much of the core UI functionality: customer creation and screening, case/alert/risk review and remediation (explicitly 'via the web application or by integrating with the API'), monitoring configuration, exports, case audit trails, IAM roles and transaction processing, all described in a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. However, API credentials are generated only in the web application, and there is no evidence that screening configurations or the risk-score equation can be managed through the API. No parity claim is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API management of credentials, screening configurations and risk-scoring equations, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
